commits.author: ivangfr
commits.message:
chore: dependency upgrades and resilience improvements

- Deps: Spring Boot 4.0.4 → 4.0.6, Spring Cloud 2025.1.0 → 2025.1.1, springdoc-openapi 3.0.2 → 3.0.3, Maven wrapper 3.9.11 → 3.9.14
- Frontend: jQuery 3.7.1 → 4.0.0 (new CDN), STOMP.js 2.3.3 → @stomp/stompjs 7.3.0 (new API + CDN), day.js 1.11.13 → 1.11.18
- API: GET /api/bitcoin/last now returns 404 when no price exists; SimulationRunner skips seeding if data already present; cron expression externalized to a property; MySQL credentials use env vars
- Code quality: BINDING_NAME constant extracted, unused @Slf4j removed, chat form validation feedback added
- Docs/config: AGENTS.md updated, FUNDING.yml gets Buy Me a Coffee link

commits.author: ivangfr
commits.message:
chore(infra): harden shell scripts and improve docker compose reliability

- derive APP_VERSION from maven instead of hardcoding it

- make remove-docker-images.sh dynamic and handle missing images gracefully
- remove broken tcp health-cmd from start-apps.sh docker run calls

- improve kafka healthcheck to use kafka-topics instead of nc
- add --silent to mysql healthcheck to suppress password warnings
- refactor my-functions.sh for correctness and shellcheck compliance
- add newline at end of my-functions.sh and fix shebang comment
